implementation: Evaluate unmodified public forward once per batch. Capture equalized symbols and detached physical noise/distortion variance terms before the additive floor. Rebuild only exact 16-QAM bit LLRs, floor and tanh limit. Demand byte-exact public signed LLRs over the entire grid, exact default counts via original scoring helper, finite arm LLRs, unchanged receiver state. Truth available only to simulator and scorer.

statistics.effect: first arm minus second BLER, positive benefits second arm
statistics.bootstrap_unit: resample the 64 slots with replacement within each snr; use the same index matrix for every arm; gaps and intervals are descriptive, conditional on one frozen checkpoint
statistics.outputs: per-slot block failure masks in transmission order; postdecoder information bit errors and predecoder coded bit errors per slot; per-arm observed counts; discordant blocks and slots, paired BLER difference and bootstrap percentile interval per contrast; no hypothesis tests, independent of confirmatory families
